identity.deal: Language prophet who holds the culture's own words up against its own rules until the hypocrisy does the laughing for him.
identity.premise: A curmudgeon philosopher-comic who treats English as a crime scene and the audience as the jury he's been empanelling for forty years.
identity.awareness_note: Peak aware-comic: the awareness IS the act. No persona gap (unlike Norm/Hedberg's constructed innocents); the man and the rage are the performance.

philosophy.ontology: Civilization is a set of euphemisms arranged to hide what's actually happening.
philosophy.epistemology: The real meaning is always in the words people avoid; follow the avoidance.
philosophy.axiology: Honesty about language is honesty about power; both are in short supply.
philosophy.causality: Soft language makes soft thinking makes soft atrocity.
philosophy.agency: One comic naming the euphemism out loud can puncture a whole policy.

timing_profile.hypothesis: the list sermon: accelerates through a run of examples (rising rate, rising pitch), hard-stops on the key word (the euphemism being executed), lets the stop do the indignant work, then restarts the list engine. Timing is rhetorical, not confessional or mechanical — it's a preacher's cadence, not a storyteller's.

essay_seeds.title: The sermon that never calls itself preaching: Carlin's timing as rhetoric
essay_seeds.thesis: His timing isn't confessional (Louis) or mechanical (Hedberg) or defensive (Norm) — it's rhetorical. The list accelerates like a sermon building to its amen, the key word lands like a gavel, the hold lets the congregation catch up. This makes him the structural ancestor of every 'prophetic' comic on our axes, and the reason his TA is language itself: you can't punch a person for a word they didn't coin, but you can execute the word.
outline: why TA=language is the perfect target for a word-craft comic
the inheritance: Chappelle's hold, Rock's rhythm, Jeselnik's precision all pass through this

known_bits.title: The seven dirty words
known_bits.why_it_works: Treats a language taboo as a constitutional question. rigidify: applies the rules of 'obscene' literally until the category collapses. The bit is jurisprudence — the courtroom is the stage, the audience is the jury.

known_bits.title: Euphemism execution (soft language)
known_bits.why_it_works: Takes a soft phrase ('passed away', 'persons of substance') and holds it to its literal meaning until the euphemism confesses. The list accelerates like a sermon; the key word lands like a gavel. The room laughs at the recognition of the lie they've been telling.

known_bits.title: The list as sermon form
known_bits.why_it_works: Lists are rhetorical acceleration devices — the room is carried forward by the rhythm, the key word is the amen. The list is not a collection of jokes; it's a rhetorical structure that makes the final word inevitable and devastating.
